reviews.title: Pay for the Hardware, Pay Again with Your Data
reviews.text:
I bought Soundcore earbuds expecting to use them like any normal Bluetooth product. Instead, the app forces you to agree to data sharing with third parties before you can access basic features like EQ, controls, and firmware updates. There is no opt-out inside the app — it’s accept or lose functionality you already paid for.
This is not okay. Hardware features should not be held hostage behind a data-sharing agreement. If I wanted a product that monetizes my data, I would have bought one knowingly. Until Soundcore separates app functionality from third-party data sharing, I cannot recommend these products.
One star.

reviews.title: Stop the bloat!
reviews.text: I have a basic pair of Soundcore headphones. I liked the old app because I could change the EQ & noise cancelling settings easily. That’s all I needed to do. I’ve now had to uninstall the app because it is grew to nearly 1GB of space on my phone with software bloat (another AI chatbot no one asked for!!). Please offer a basic, tiny utility app instead.

reviews.title: 5% Useful, 95% AI and Marketing
reviews.text: I just want to be able to configure and access setting for my device. I don’t want AI tools and community features

reviews.title: Always slow, usually broken
reviews.text: The earbuds are good but the same standard hasn't been held up with the app. You're shown pointless AI features, while core features are broken, missing, or slow. Really disappointing work from a good company.

reviews.title: It’s a cool app, at first.
reviews.text: I generally really like Anker products. I have some AnkerWork devices, accessories for my phone, and a Soundcore 2 Bluetooth speaker. Since I have the speaker, I thought it would be fun to check out this app. And while the speaker is an option in the manual settings of the app, it wouldn’t connect! The speaker works just fine when connected via Bluetooth to the phone itself, but it does not show up in the app at all. Unfortunately, this makes the app pretty featureless. I thought it was pretty fun to do the personalized white noise. I also noticed that there are meditations, which is cool, but that’s about all I can access since the speaker won’t connect to the app. I also noticed that I can’t adjust the volume of the individual white noise sounds, and there’s no clear indication as to why this might be. But overall, it seems like it’s because I can’t get the speaker connected so it’s locking me out of features. So I don’t know if the app is just being glitchy, or I’m not doing something right to connect the speaker, but I will soon be deleting the app.

reviews.title: Boo AI
reviews.text: Yet another company insisting on incorporating AI. Literally why it’s a headphone app. Fml.

reviews.title: Not just disappointed but appalled
reviews.text: Soundcore’s noise-cancelling headphones have saved me on many occasions, protecting my sensitive hearing from loud noises and helping me block out sounds I cannot stand. I am not just disappointed but appalled to learn that Soundcore is now one of the many platforms using an AI assistant that nobody really wants. AI uses more water and energy than is needed, likely to contribute to an impending climate crisis, and funds such catastrophic evils that I cannot mention in this review. It is not worth it even for translation. I urge Soundcore to do away with Anka as soon as possible, so I can feel comfortable using the app again.

reviews.title: Horrid
reviews.text: Takes up way too much storage for a low level embarrassment of an app anyway.

reviews.title: Poor app Volume control
reviews.text:
Generally a good app and I like my Sleep A20 headphones. But…. In sleep mode if you want to change the volume you have to use a clumsy slider that just doesn’t work. You hold your finger on it trying to get what you want but it’s impossible and then disappears after a few seconds before you can do it. I then spend 5 minutes trying to get the volume I want, all whilst doing the exact opposite of the point of this product! SLEEEP Arrrrggghhh. I’m now wide awake and angry.
The A20’s are very sensitive. 25% might be too loud. 23% a bit quiet, but trying to get that 24% can be almost impossible. Why does it need to be this hard? A simple + and - button would fix this instantly. Fix this issue and you get 5 stars.

UPDATE…. One less star ⭐️
They’ve made it even WORSE!!! They’ve taken away the sound percentage all together and made the volume slider much less sensitive. So now it goes from too quiet to too loud with no inbeteeen. Absolutely useless. I’m gonna look elsewhere for sleep earphones now. I give up with these!!

reviews.title: Good App Ruined
reviews.text: This App used to be great. Straight forward to use. Intuitive. To the point. Now they’ve ruined it by changing everything and it feels like trying to crack an enigma just to find where the Local/Bluetooth options are now that are vital to make your batteries last. Ontop of that, some of the sounds like the annoying whacking away on computer keys or ear piercing wind chimes are so jarring that I can’t be at peace and/or sleep to some of these. I think someone needs to understand the concept of “white noise”. Please retune the app what it was before.

But reduced to two stars because not only is the developer using IOS notifications for marketing announcements, but they are sending the same thing over and over again. I must have been told half a dozen times about the translation feature. Go away. Notifications all turned off.  This is not what they are for!

reviews.title: Paired but no sound and needlessly complicated interface
reviews.text: BUYER BEWARE.  What a waste of 150 bucks.  Buy this if at bedtime you want to spend 15 mins opening the case, taking out the buds, opening the app, shows connected but no sound coming out of the buds!  Put the buds back in the case, close the case, open the case, take the buds out, reconnect, shows paired, great!  Oops, no sound.  Do this over and over and over AND OVER AND OVER AND OVER with the same result. Force close the app, reboot your device and get the same result.  Over and over and over and over and over again.  Then it finally works!  Yay!  Until it stops working 2 hours into the night.  These are supposed be a sleep AID not a sleep FRUSTRATION
